name: gitpatch-viewer
description: Offline viewer for unified diff patches

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --minify --define:__APP_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" --define:__APP_COMMIT__=\"$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)\" --define:__APP_TAGGED__=\"$(git tag --points-at HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "v$npm_package_version" && echo 1)\" --outdir=dist && cp src/index.html src/_headers dist/
scripts.dev: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --define:__APP_VERSION__=\"$npm_package_version\" --define:__APP_COMMIT__=\"$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)\" --define:__APP_TAGGED__=\"$(git tag --points-at HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "v$npm_package_version" && echo 1)\" --outdir=dist --watch
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
